_comment: SAMPLE live-detection stream for the 'Live feed' overlay. In production this is emitted in real time by the video-intelligence path (studio/director/vision.py + studio/vision/ → Gemini open-vocabulary detect) as the user looks at a REAL engine. Each detection renders through the SAME identify/hitbox overlay as authored elements, closing the loop to placement-recognition (MF p28/p40). Boxes are in metres in the viewer's world frame; a real feed supplies these from camera→world projection.
